scopeLabel: Main-only source-scoped CdSe core synthesis, direct and stepwise CdS shelling, reported failed controls and post-growth variants, specimen preparation and optical/structural characterization. All fourteen main pages were actually read as text and images. Local Supporting Information is absent; unreported charges, durations and physical batch identities remain unknown. This is a selected synthesis and figure review, not a complete laboratory SOP or full-paper narrative Reader.

availability.morphology_illustration: Source images and specimen facts are retained. Complex finite particle shapes, shell faults, interfaces, substrates and ligands are not reconstructed from incomplete geometric information. Optional independent bulk CdSe/CdS references are restricted to the specifically named core or STEM contexts.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
